title.zh: 效果机架跟着编排走：界面与协议都能改，且渲染真的带上
title.en: The effect rack follows the arrangement — editable in the UI and over the protocol, and carried into a render

highlights.zh: set_arrangement_effects 增加 rack：滤波 cutoff/Q/type、饱和 drive、合唱 mix/rate、位深，部分补丁、越界钳位。只改一个阶段不会重置其它阶段。
highlights.en: set_arrangement_effects now takes a rack: filter cutoff/Q/type, saturation drive, chorus mix/rate and bit depth — a partial patch, clamped, where naming one stage leaves the others as the genre left them.

highlights.zh: 修掉一个会静默丢设置的缺陷：界面的机架旋钮只推给引擎、没有存储，genre 变更或重载就会把它改回去。现在写入编排并与协议同一份存储。
highlights.en: One silent defect fixed: the interface's rack knobs pushed values at the engine and stored nothing, so a genre change or a reload rewrote them. They now store on the arrangement, the same place the protocol writes.
